    @torch.no_grad()
    def analyze_matched_suffix_control(self, batches, max_rows=64, seed=42):
        # This is an inference intervention on one checkpoint, not a comparison
        # of independently trained A/B/C conditions or their validation HR@10.
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        records = []
        remaining = max_rows
        was_training = self.model.training
        self.model.eval()
        try:
            for batch in batches:
                if remaining <= 0:
                    break
                seq, pos, neg = [
                    torch.as_tensor(value, device=self.device, dtype=torch.long)
                    for value in batch[1:4]
                ]
                if seq.ndim != 2 or pos.shape != seq.shape or neg.shape != seq.shape:
                    raise ValueError("Diagnostic inputs must be aligned B x L tensors")
                seq, pos, neg = [value[:remaining] for value in (seq, pos, neg)]
                remaining -= seq.size(0)
                if any(
                    ((ids < 0) | (ids > self.model.itemnum)).any().item()
                    for ids in (seq, pos, neg)
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Diagnostic item IDs exceed the vocabulary")

                keep = torch.zeros_like(seq, dtype=torch.bool)
                lengths = seq.ne(0).sum(dim=1)
                for row in range(seq.size(0)):
                    positions = seq[row].ne(0).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
                    n = int(positions.numel())
                    if n == 0:
                        continue
                    k = n
                    if rng.random() < 0.5:
                        k = int(rng.integers(max(1, (n + 1) // 2), n + 1))
                    keep[row, positions[-k:]] = True

                cropped = seq.masked_fill(~keep, 0)
                candidates = torch.stack((pos, neg), dim=-1)
                full_features = self.view.log2feats(seq)
                crop_features = self.view.log2feats(cropped)
                for features in (full_features, crop_features):
                    if features.ndim != 3 or features.shape[:2] != seq.shape:
                        raise ValueError("log2feats must return aligned B x L x H")
                full_scores = self.view.predict_score(full_features, candidates)
                crop_scores = self.view.predict_score(crop_features, candidates)
                if full_scores.shape != candidates.shape or crop_scores.shape != candidates.shape:
                    raise ValueError("Expected aligned B x L x 2 diagnostic scores")
                full_margin = (full_scores[..., 0] - full_scores[..., 1]).float()
                crop_margin = (crop_scores[..., 0] - crop_scores[..., 1]).float()
                valid = seq.ne(0) & pos.ne(0) & neg.ne(0)
                retained = valid & keep
                if not torch.isfinite(full_scores[valid]).all().item():
                    raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite full-context diagnostic scores")
                if not torch.isfinite(crop_scores[retained]).all().item():
                    raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite cropped-context diagnostic scores")

                for row in range(seq.size(0)):
                    all_valid = valid[row]
                    matched = retained[row]
                    if not matched.any().item():
                        continue
                    a = full_margin[row, all_valid]
                    b = full_margin[row, matched]
                    c = crop_margin[row, matched]
                    delta = c - b
                    if not all(torch.isfinite(x).all().item() for x in (a, b, c, delta)):
                        raise FloatingPointError("Nonfinite matched diagnostic margins")
                    b_wrong = b < 0
                    c_wrong = c < 0
                    records.append(
                        {
                            "length": int(lengths[row].item()),
                            "retained_inputs": int(keep[row].sum().item()),
                            "all_valid_positions": int(all_valid.sum().item()),
                            "matched_positions": int(matched.sum().item()),
                            "full_all_margin_mean": float(a.mean().item()),
                            "full_matched_margin_mean": float(b.mean().item()),
                            "cropped_matched_margin_mean": float(c.mean().item()),
                            "paired_margin_delta": float(delta.mean().item()),
                            "full_matched_wrong_rate": float(b_wrong.float().mean().item()),
                            "cropped_matched_wrong_rate": float(c_wrong.float().mean().item()),
                            "correct_to_wrong_rate": float(
                                ((~b_wrong) & c_wrong).float().mean().item()
                            ),
                            "wrong_to_correct_rate": float(
                                (b_wrong & (~c_wrong)).float().mean().item()
                            ),
                        }
                    )
        finally:
            self.model.train(was_training)

        def summarize(rows):
            keys = (
                "full_all_margin_mean", "full_matched_margin_mean",
                "cropped_matched_margin_mean", "paired_margin_delta",
                "full_matched_wrong_rate", "cropped_matched_wrong_rate",
                "correct_to_wrong_rate", "wrong_to_correct_rate",
            )
            return {
                "eligible_rows": len(rows),
                "all_valid_positions": sum(r["all_valid_positions"] for r in rows),
                "matched_positions": sum(r["matched_positions"] for r in rows),
                "rows_with_context_removed": sum(
                    r["retained_inputs"] < r["length"] for r in rows
                ),
                **{
                    key: float(np.mean([r[key] for r in rows])) if rows else None
                    for key in keys
                },
            }

        return {
            "policy": {
                "crop_branch_probability": 0.5,
                "minimum_retained_fraction": 0.5,
                "retained_count_upper_bound_inclusive": True,
                "seed": seed,
                "maximum_rows": max_rows,
            },
            "overall": summarize(records),
            "history_length_strata": {
                "1_to_9": summarize([r for r in records if r["length"] < 10]),
                "10_to_49": summarize([r for r in records if 10 <= r["length"] < 50]),
                "50_plus": summarize([r for r in records if r["length"] >= 50]),
            },
        }
